mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS settlementId, s.payment_id AS paymentId, p.refundable_amount AS newAmount, ROUND(p.refundable_amount * #{pgFeeRate}) AS newPgFeeAmount, ROUND(p.refundable_amount * #{platformFeeRate}) AS newPlatformFeeAmount, p.refundable_amount - ROUND(p.refundable_amount * #{pgFeeRate}) - ROUND(p.refundable_amount * #{platformFeeRate}) AS newNetAmount FROM settlement s JOIN payment p ON p.id = s.payment_id WHERE s.status = 'PENDING' AND s.is_deleted = false AND s.amount <> p.refundable_amount AND s.id > #{lastId} ORDER BY s.id ASC LIMIT #{chunkSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement SET amount = #{candidate.newAmount}, pg_fee_amount = #{candidate.newPgFeeAmount}, platform_fee_amount = #{candidate.newPlatformFeeAmount}, net_amount = #{candidate.newNetAmount}, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{candidate.settlementId} AND status = 'PENDING'
